title: Universal Media Decomposer architecture options analysis
body: Reviewed Task.md, upstream technology research, and complete T1-T8 adversarial log. Greenfield repository has no prior ADRs or implementation constraints. Surviving architecture is a single Postgres semantic ledger with versioned/upcastable events, shared Tier-0/Tier-1 reducer, single-writer rebuildable projections, OCFL immutable blobs, stable versioned locators, Hatchet primary with handler-level DB dedup, and Neo4j/RDF as disposable projections only. Key residuals to preserve: pyannote weights license, best-effort Whisper hallucination filtering, sandbox platform profile/caps, splink/DuckDB build benchmark, Hatchet exact pin, FFmpeg CVE watch, split-time reference enumeration, and OCFL local spooling. Preparing durable options report with A lead and B/C/D alternatives, scored tradeoffs, ownership map, interfaces/repository shape, rejected authorities, and requirement coverage.

title: Architecture options report completed
body: Created artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-architecture-options.md. It contains four concrete approaches (A Postgres ledger + projections, B RDF-star/GraphDB authority, C XTDB authority, D Neo4j authority + changelog), weighted 1–5 tradeoff matrix, implementation architecture/data flows, recommended A rationale, rejection/demotion table, normative ownership map, repository/interface suggestions, Task.md coverage/proof obligations, and unresolved risks/gates. Verified git diff --check clean and aft_inspect reports no errors; Markdown has no authoritative LSP producer, explicitly noted by inspect.
